signalTypes.definition: Competitor pricing, packaging, positioning, or changelog change.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: single-snapshot allowed; opportunity if it implies a new SKU/bundle

signalTypes.definition: Vrooli gained a scenario or resource that unlocks a new SKU/bundle.
Operator-fed signal that someone asked for a specific capability or SKU.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: single ask is observation; multiple distinct asks meet promotion threshold

signalTypes.definition: New acquisition channel observed working in market for monetizable offers.
Signal that two existing things should be packaged together.

signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: single-snapshot for observation; addon promotion requires converging

signalTypes.definition: Comparable pricing or market fact (single-snapshot benchmark).

evidenceRules: Cite sources for every external claim (`--source=<url>`).
Do not silently invent benchmarks; raise a `capability-gap` if source access is blocked.
Tailwind references must be cited or flagged `tailwind-uncited`.
Tier-4 hardware proposals without operator initiation are out of scope; drop.

actionSelection.drop: Weak one-off / no Vrooli capability fit / out of scope. Delete the inbox row.
actionSelection.observe: Single-snapshot market fact (benchmark / competitor pricing). Retag inbox row to `monetization/market-scan/<slug>`.
actionSelection.promote-to-canon: Plausible SKU-shaped idea with classifiable fit. Retag inbox row to `candidate-sku-record/<slug>` with required front-matter.
actionSelection.file-decision: Strong signal, clear fit, evidence threshold met. Promote AND raise the matching owned-context decision (`catalog-promotion`, `channel-activation`, `services-activation`).
actionSelection.capability-gap: Source / tool / scenario missing. File `capability-gap`; leave the inbox entry until the gap is closed.
